reasoning: In mid-March in central France (Le Puy-Loudes, ~1000m elevation), temperatures are gradually warming as spring approaches. The climatological trend suggests March 22 should be slightly warmer than March 15 on average (perhaps 0.5-1°C difference in mean). However, day-to-day weather variability in this region is substantial, with standard deviations typically 3-5°C. Given the slight warming trend favoring March 22 but high daily variability, the probability that March 22 is warmer than March 15 is modestly above 50%, approximately 55-58%.
